provider: NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) POWER Project
product: POWER spatial Zarr stores (AWS Open Data): MERRA-2 (T2M, PRECTOTCORR, WS10M) and CERES SYN1deg (ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, CLRSKY_SFC_SW_DWN); climatology + monthly, LST
accessMethod: download (anonymous S3 / Zarr subset by variable and time)

licence.name: NASA POWER open data (acknowledgement required)
licence.attribution: These data were obtained from the NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) POWER Project funded through the NASA Earth Science/Applied Science Program.
licence.notes: Also acknowledge underlying products: NASA GMAO MERRA-2 (meteorology) and NASA CERES SYN1deg (solar). Verify against the POWER referencing page before publishing.

query: s3://nasa-power/merra2/spatial/power_merra2_climatology_spatial_lst.zarr vars=T2M,PRECTOTCORR,WS10M time=1..13 (12 months + annual), full global lat/lon; s3://nasa-power/merra2/spatial/power_merra2_monthly_spatial_lst.zarr vars=T2M,PRECTOTCORR,WS10M time in 2024-01..2024-12 (12 monthly steps), full global lat/lon; s3://nasa-power/syn1deg/spatial/power_syn1deg_climatology_spatial_lst.zarr vars=ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN,CLRSKY_SFC_SW_DWN time=1..13 (12 months + annual), full global lat/lon; s3://nasa-power/syn1deg/spatial/power_syn1deg_monthly_spatial_lst.zarr vars=ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN,CLRSKY_SFC_SW_DWN time in 2024-01..2024-12 (12 monthly steps), full global lat/lon

nativeResolution.merra2: MERRA-2, 0.5 deg lat x 0.625 deg lon (361 x 576 grid, centres lat -90..90, lon -180..179.375)
nativeResolution.syn1deg: CERES SYN1deg Ed4.x, 1 deg x 1 deg (180 x 360 grid, centres lat -89.5..89.5, lon -179.5..179.5)

timeStandard: LST (matches the POWER climatology/monthly API; verified at 33.5,-112.5)
climatologyPeriodNote: Zarr attrs state time_coverage 2001-01-01..2020-12-31; the POWER climatology API returns identical values at the checked point labelled 'January 2001 - December 2025'. Unresolved.

units.ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN: raw .nc: W m-2 (daily-mean irradiance); prepared: kWh/m^2/day = W m-2 x 0.024, the unit the POWER API publishes (verified: 243.65 W m-2 -> 5.8476, API ANN 5.8476)

processing.method: Every H3 res-6 cell (14,117,882; enumerated via cell_to_children of the 122 res-0 cells) takes the value of the native grid cell nearest its centre (longitude wraps; latitude clipped).
processing.warning: Values repeat across all H3 cells within one native grid cell (~0.5 x 0.625 deg or 1 x 1 deg, i.e. ~2,000-12,000 km2 at the equator vs ~36 km2 per res-6 cell). They are NOT finer-resolution measurements; adjacent cells straddling a native boundary may step abruptly.
processing.nodata: NaN/_FillValue -> Parquet null, never 0 (no nulls occur in these global model fields).
processing.evidence: MERRA-2 is a reanalysis (model + assimilated observations); SYN1deg is satellite-derived (CERES) with modelled radiative transfer. Neither is an in-situ measurement.
processing.parquetSchema: h3 uint64 (sorted) + float32 columns m01..m12 (+ ann for climatology); per-file schema metadata key 'power' holds JSON provenance incl. native_res and units.
